visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair is seen in a close-up shot inside a vehicle. She looks toward the camera with a distressed expression while rain streaks across the window behind her. (2) The camera pans to show tall, modern glass skyscrapers in an urban setting under a heavy, grey, overcast sky with significant rainfall blurring the view. (3) Back in the car, the woman continues to speak, touching her neck; she is dressed in a light-colored top. (4) Transition to an indoor office environment with a light yellow wall and a blue circular logo that reads 'PETIT'. The woman is sitting at a desk with a laptop, interacting with a female colleague in glasses. (5) The scene shifts to the woman walking outdoors under a pink umbrella during a torrential downpour. She is wearing a beige blazer over a dark top and has a hood over her head. (6) She is seen walking up a flight of stairs inside a building with large glass windows showing the rainy street outside. (7) Indoors at an event venue, the woman introduces a smiling man in a dark blue shirt who is holding a professional camera rig with a gimbal. (8) She interacts with a woman in a floral white dress on a stage background. They smile and hug each other warmly. (9) A sequence of clips from a documentary plays, showing a masked palm civet on a shelf and a pangolin walking through foliage. There is footage of a medical ultrasound being performed on an animal. (10) The woman and the floral-dressed anchor stand together in a brightly lit studio/event space, gesturing towards the camera and speaking enthusiastically.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video follows a creator's hectic rainy day, moving from a late meeting to a press event for a wildlife program called 'My Wild Classmate'. Its ultimate goal is to promote the broadcast schedule of the show while engaging the audience through a personal vlog format.
